overall_reason: An untinted grey table (#222222 title, #444444 task names, #999999 on 14 elements for headers, owners, dates and status) with a rule under the header and every row.

score.reason: T-NEUTRALS passes with one temperature; T-PALETTE-ROLES finds status, owners and dates all in one grey, and T-LINE-DELETION finds a rule on every row.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.evidence: The text roles list #999999 on 14 small elements: column headers, owners, due dates, the count and the status values 'Ready' and 'In review'.
findings.after: Status in ink or a state colour with its word, distinct from headers and metadata.
findings.why: The column a reader scans for has no colour role.

findings.title: Draw lines only to separate regions, encode state, or carry data
findings.evidence: The table draws a hairline under the header row and between each of the 3 rows inside a bordered card.
findings.after: Rows separated by space, with one rule under the header.
findings.why: Repeated rules add noise to a three-row table.

strengths: One untinted grey family and no shadows.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
